name: workpal-agent
description: WorkPal local agent — menu-bar shell + local API (Phase 7.1 + 7.2)

scripts.copy:renderer: mkdir -p dist-renderer && cp src/renderer/index.html dist-renderer/ && cp src/renderer/styles.css dist-renderer/ && cp assets/workpal-logo.svg dist-renderer/
scripts.dev: npm run build:ts && npm run copy:renderer && electron .
scripts.pack: npm run build:ts && npm run copy:renderer && electron-builder --mac --dir
scripts.dist: npm run build:ts && npm run copy:renderer && electron-builder --mac
